Paul Laurence Dunbar, The Uncalled.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/paul-laurence-dunbar/the-uncalled

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Paul Laurence Dunbar, the author, died 1906 (Wikidata Q974678, P570 = 1906-02-09; Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Laurence_Dunbar).

First publication of the text used: 'The Uncalled was published in 1898 by Paul Laurence Dunbar.' (SE colophon).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1898, before 1929. Works published before 1929 entered the United States public domain by 1 January 2025, and Standard Ebooks states the same in its rights statement (below).
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1906 or earlier; the last to die was Paul Laurence Dunbar in 1906 (Wikidata Q974678, P570 = 1906-02-09). So the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
